# Param Darshan - Sacred Pooja & Astrology Live Streaming Platform

> Param Darshan is India's real-time devotional live-streaming and spiritual consultation platform, connecting devotees worldwide with verified Vedic priests, temples, and astrologers for live sacred rituals, aarti, sankalp, and Vedic astrological consultations.

## Core Services & Pages
- [Live Darshan Broadcasts](https://paramdarshan.com/): Real-time WebRTC and HLS live streams from registered temples and spiritual sanctuaries.
- [Free Vedic Kundli & Charts](https://paramdarshan.com/kundli/): Free instant Janam Kundli, Lagna (D1) and Navamsa (D9) SVG charts, and client-side PDF export.
- [Sacred Poojas & Schedule](https://paramdarshan.com/schedule/): Daily live aarti, havan yagya, and Vedic anushthan schedule.
- [Pooja Services](https://paramdarshan.com/pooja/): Interactive online pooja ceremonies and sankalp offerings.
- [Streamer Onboarding](https://paramdarshan.com/streamer/apply/): KYC-verified Pandit and Acharya registration portal.
- [Devotee Help & FAQ](https://paramdarshan.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions on sacred coins, pooja bookings, and technical support.
- [Contact Support](https://paramdarshan.com/contact/): Customer care (+91-92122-83098, WhatsApp +91-96708-42038, Email paramdarshan.com@gmail.com), Acharya onboarding, and platform inquiries.
- [Terms & DPDP Act 2023 Compliance](https://paramdarshan.com/terms/): Legal terms, 18+ age verification, and personal data protection policy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://paramdarshan.com/privacy/): Digital personal data handling, encryption standards, and retention schedules.
- [Refund Policy](https://paramdarshan.com/refund/): Sacred Coins refund and failed payment auto-reversal guidelines.
- [Grievance Redressal Officer](https://paramdarshan.com/grievance/): IT Rules 2021 statutory grievance escalation channel.

## Machine-Readable Resources & APIs
- [Sitemap XML](https://paramdarshan.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all public canonical routes.

- [Database Ready Probe](https://paramdarshan.com/api/v1/health/ready): Public database connectivity probe.
